messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — quick check on LumosEdge onboarding. We saw a ~20% p95 latency bump on their prod route over the last 12h. Chart: https://redwood.app/dash/xyz :eyes:

InfraBot: Alert — route lumosedge-prod latency p95 20% up vs baseline. Incident ID: INC-5175

Maya (CSM): They've been in trial growth; renewal touchpoint next month. Suggest proactive perf play: propose INT8 quant canary + routing policy to low-latency variant. Want to run 10% canary for 24h.

Priya (ML Eng): +1. For their workload (avg seq 128) q4_0 or int8 quantized gpt-2-ish variant should be safe. Locally ran eval on our testset: token perf +33%, 0.6% metric degrade on our regression set.

Priya (ML Eng): Suggested canary fields:
```
route: lumosedge-prod
canary: 10%
model_variant: lumosedge-qint8-v1
fallback: lumosedge-vanilla-v2
eval_set: lumosedge-regression-2026-03
monitor: p95_latency, nll, hallucination_rate
```

Leo (LumosEdge-SRE): Confirmed they push variable batch sizes. Need to watch tail latencies and also their L7 gateway timeouts. QA will run sample prompts for NLU edge cases.

Ethan (AE): Can we schedule a 30m enablement call tomorrow 11am PST to align on rollout and talking points for renewal? I'll invite CS and the customer.

Priya (ML Eng): Will add quality gates: auto-rollback if hallucination_rate > 1.5x baseline or avg_nll increases by >0.8. Logging: token-level diffs stored behind customer key (KMS).

Maya (CSM): Action items: 1) Priya to start canary + post daily summary. 2) Ethan to schedule call + update renewal risk doc. 3) Leo/Customer to run QA prompts. I'll ping renewal owner after 24h.

Leo (LumosEdge-SRE): On it. Also would like a quick knob to route 100% to vanilla on sustained p95 > 1.25x baseline.

Priya (ML Eng): Got it. I'll wire the auto-route policy: if p95 > 1.25x baseline for 15m -> revert routing to lumosedge-vanilla-v2 and mark canary failed.

Maya (CSM): Thanks all. Leaving a note on renewal radar: "Potential risk mitigated if canary stable; escalate to AE if not." :memo:

InfraBot: Canary deployed to 10% at 2026-03-20T15:12Z. Monitor IDs: MON-5175-CAN1

Ethan (AE): Thx! Maya, looping in renewal lead @Nora tomorrow.

Maya (CSM): Perfect. Will capture feedback and share with Product if any regressions.
